acceptance: Site CI fails a PR that adds a comment the policy forbids
The check runs in lefthook pre-commit
Existing allowed comments are recorded so main passes
context:
Found 2026-10-17 at site-split closeout by grepping benchbox-site main 8812af7 for comment-policy (no matches). Listed as a follow-up in site-split-99.

Moved to the BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site tracker (todo-state branch of that repository) under the same id on 2026-10-30; track it there.
description:
Core enforces its comment policy on every PR (quality/comment-policy.json, scripts/check_comment_policy.py, the required comment-policy check, .pre-commit-config.yaml:7-13), and that scope used to cover website/ and results-explorer/ (quality/comment-policy.json:252,257). Those trees now live in benchbox-site, and nothing there checks comments: no workflow, lefthook.yml entry or script in benchbox-site mentions a comment policy (.github/workflows/ has only ci.yml, deploy.yml, nightly.yml and visual.yml). New comments in the site's TypeScript and Astro source are unchecked.

Port an equivalent check to the site in Node (ADR D9: no Python in the site repo), run it in site CI and lefthook, and seed it with the current state.
